summary_en: 200,000 shares (0.5% S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥500M. Open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange, mandate-delegation method. Execution window Aug 26, 2026–Jan 29, 2027. Purpose: shareholder returns, capital efficiency, and stock-based compensation funding.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Stock (Acquisition of Own Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc. announced on August 25, 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 200,000 ordinary shares (0.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥500 million. The purchase will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using a mandate-delegation arrangement with a securities firm, with execution running from August 26, 2026 through January 29, 2027. The stated purpose is twofold: to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, and to secure shares for allocation as equity-based incentive compensation. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 1,914,056 treasury shares against 38,511,944 shares outstanding (ex-treasury) out of 40,426,000 total issued shares.
